answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond on the ledge board and posts one signed record per epoch. Any peer may challenge with a matching bond; an umber panel replays the record and burns the loser's bond. Two failures drop it to its nadir and freeze the bond. Shared funding trails cluster identities, so the k-th fake pays an 8 times (k-1) fee; the 1,000th costs 8,062. For 1,000 fakes the attacker locks 70,000 and pays 3,996,000 in fees, with no reuse. A rented-challenge shield fails because challenges stay open; an honest identity locks 70 once, refundable after a clean epoch.
